`GET /invoices/<id>` in `src/api/invoices.py` now returns a 404 when the invoice doesn't exist. I haven't run it or added a test.

The 404 body is an RFC 7807 problem+json response built with `errors.problem(404, "Invoice not found", ...)`. That follows the project's API error-format convention, so clients that parse error bodies will get the usual shape. The `detail` field reads "No invoice with id <id>".

Before this change, a missing invoice made the handler call `.__dict__` on `None`, which would have raised and returned a 500.

I didn't save anything to memory. The error-format convention was already recorded, and nothing new came up.
